dialogues.speaker: Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: Pankration Recreational Tournament Results: Congratulations to the researcher and her assistant for their victory in this Recreational Tournament! Congrats to their coach as well!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Rules for last-minute participation should be written into the competition rules."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "This competition is so boring. Don't you have anything more exciting?"

dialogues.speaker: Someone Else's Message
dialogues.text: "You can take the stage and give things a whirl yourself! Interested parties can register with Roussimoff."
